standard_prerequisites.name: The scheme theoretic image of a morphism of algebraic stacks, characterised by the closed substacks through which the morphism factors
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The author's section on scheme theoretic images, in which the counted statement occurs
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the universal property against which existence and equality are tested.

standard_prerequisites.name: The fibre product of a morphism along a surjective flat morphism of finite presentation is again surjective flat of finite presentation, so that it admits an fppf covering by a scheme
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof (source lines 8768-8776)
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the covering of the test scheme by which the object is tested for membership in a closed substack.

core_obligations: Reduce to factoring through a closed substack: the proof fixes a closed substack through which the composite factors and shows that the original morphism factors through it as well, which is what the universal property of the scheme theoretic image requires (proof lines 8764-8767)

Test one object: for a scheme mapping to the source and an object of the fibre category over it, the proof passes to the fibre product along the given cover and notes that its projection to the scheme is surjective flat of finite presentation (proof lines 8768-8772)

Cover and conclude: hence there is an fppf covering along which the object comes from the cover, so that its image under the composite lies in the closed substack; since a closed substack is strictly full, the object itself lies there (proof lines 8773-8779)
proof_roadmap: 设闭子叠 Z ⊂ Y 使 f∘g 分解通过 Z；要证 f 也通过 Z。取概型 T 与 T → X（对象 x）。
T ×_X W → T 是满、平坦、局部有限表现，故有 fppf 覆盖 {T_i → T} 使 T_i → T 通过它分解；于是 T_i → Y 通过 Z 分解，即 f(x)|_{T_i} ∈ Z；由 Z 是严格全子叠得 f(x) ∈ Z。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the existence and the value of the scheme theoretic image of a morphism of algebraic stacks are unchanged when the morphism is composed with a surjective flat cover of finite presentation (author lemma at source lines 8753-8761, label lemma-cover-upstairs). The proof (source lines 8763-8780) reduces to the universal property against a closed substack, tests an arbitrary object of the source over a scheme, covers that scheme using the surjectivity and flatness of finite presentation of the projection from the fibre product, and concludes by the fact that a closed substack is strictly full (proof lines 8764-8779). The descent of the factorisation along an fppf covering is the content. H2.
